title: PG-04.1 Canonical operation envelope (memev)
request: Programme contract for work package WP04 in memev: Canonical operation envelope. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP04.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on tasks outside this contract: WP17-03. Depends on contracts: SO-1.04, SO-1.01. Covers only what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11) do not already cover; the mapping is in contracts/programme/manifest.json. Boundary with SO-1.04 and SO-1.01: WP04 depends on both: the envelope carries the four-way event distinction of SO-1.04 requirement 3 and does not define the adapter contract (SO-1.04 requirement 1) or own the store or coordinator (SO-1.01). Boundary with SO-2.07 to SO-2.11: their adapter layers must use canonical operation contracts: the WP04 envelope is that contract, and these specs do not define any adapter for those systems. Build layer (lead workstream decision under owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026): the unsigned fold (SO-A-01 to SO-A-12, SO-R-E, SO-F-01 to SO-F-13, cited by id only) is the build layer, and it overlaps this spec at SO-F-03. This spec will cite those ids and keep only what the fold does not cover; trim pending fold PR (the final fold ids come in the lead's separate pull request, branch contracts/scope-one-fold-build-layer). Nothing is trimmed yet. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.

tasks.title: Envelope specification: fields, versioning, deterministic serialisation, hash rules
requirements: MV-INT-02: One canonical operation envelope with versioned schema and deterministic serialisation: origin identity and node, operation id, causal dependencies, project and object id, type and payload, authorisation evidence, contract or policy reference, content hash, verification status (P0). (source: owner notes of 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md:41; evidence docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md:87; baseline 8.5)
SO-1.04 requirement 3: "Distinguish a requested action, an accepted dispatch, an observed execution and a verified outcome in the event history." (source: contract SO-1.04 T1)

A change to the envelope format needs a new version or magic, keeps the old decoder, and has a change-log entry; a silent change to the pinned fingerprint of a fixed envelope is a defect (source: the wire-compatibility policy of acfa-rs COMPATIBILITY.md, Apache-2.0, cited as the model; repository analysis of 1 Nov 2026, section 4 item A2)

Every envelope carries a hash of the merge contract it ran under (strategy, mapping version, policy fields); a mismatch is refused with a signal and never merged silently across versions (source: the merge-DNA gate of converge src/gates.py and tests/test_gates.py, described only; repository analysis of 1 Nov 2026, section 3.4 item C1)
